briefing.text: Marvel's VisionQuest premieres on Disney+ today with an 81% critics score.
Apple unveiled a $299 HomeView smart display, shipping November 13.
Google opened its Gemini 4 Argon model to paying developers and subscribers.
An OpenAI engineer was charged after a hidden recorder was found in a meeting room.
GTA 6 is reported to reach PC in early 2027, months after its November 19 launch.

stories.title: Apple unveils the $299 HomeView hub, a new HomePod mini and Apple TV 4K
stories.summary: Apple refreshed its smart home lineup on October 13 with a 7-inch HomeView display, HomePod mini 2 and a faster Apple TV.
stories.why: HomeView is Apple's long-rumored first smart display, taking on Amazon and Google.
stories.happened: HomeView costs $299 and launches November 13 with an A18 chip and Siri AI, MacRumors reports. HomePod mini 2 is $149 from October 30, and a $299 Apple TV 4K with an A19 chip arrives November 13. HomeView will not be sold in the EU.
stories.next: Watch for first reviews in November and the Mac event reported for later in October.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: A new Apple product category always draws heavy coverage.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Amazon and Google have sold smart displays for years.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It is one of two rounds of Apple launches reported for October.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone, Mac and HomePod. Its smart home platform, HomeKit, launched in 2014.

meme.top: Apple built a screen for your kitchen
meme.bottom: Your fridge is the last holdout
meme.take: HomeView skips the EU, so Europe's kitchens stay blissfully un-onboarded.

stories.title: Google opens Gemini 4 Argon to paying developers and subscribers
stories.summary: Google's new flagship model reached the paid Gemini API and the Gemini app on October 13, with a 1 million-token budget.
stories.why: A new top model from Google resets the race with OpenAI, Anthropic and Meta.
stories.happened: Gemini 4 Argon went live for paid Gemini API developers on October 13 after a limited preview, The New Stack reports. Intro pricing is $2 and $10 per million input and output tokens until November 30, then $4 and $20. Input and output share one 1 million-token budget.
stories.next: Watch for independent benchmark comparisons and the price change after November 30.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It lands a day after Meta's Muse Wonder launch.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Gemini is Google's main answer to ChatGPT and Claude.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Introductory pricing doubles after November 30.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's family of AI models and its chatbot app. Google DeepMind develops the models.

meme.bottom: Ask a novel, get a haiku back
meme.take: Gemini 4 Argon is half price until November 30. Then it remembers its worth.

stories.title: Marvel's VisionQuest debuts on Disney+ with an 81% critics score
stories.summary: Paul Bettany returns as Vision in an eight-episode series that premieres on Disney+ on October 14.
stories.why: VisionQuest continues a story Marvel fans have followed since WandaVision.
stories.happened: VisionQuest premieres on Disney+ on October 14 with an 81% Tomatometer score, Rotten Tomatoes reports. Critics call it clever and well acted but somewhat disconnected from the wider Marvel universe. James Spader voices Ultron.
stories.next: Watch for audience reaction and Disney+ viewing figures after the premiere.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Marvel series still draw some of streaming's biggest audiences.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Paul Bettany has played Vision since 2015.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Reviews are split, from Rotten Tomatoes praise to Rolling Stone's pan.

stories.background: Marvel Studios is owned by Disney and releases its series on Disney+. Vision first appeared in Avengers: Age of Ultron.

meme.top: Vision died, came back, got a series
meme.take: In the Marvel universe, death is less an ending than a contract renegotiation.

stories.title: OpenAI engineer charged after a hidden recorder is found in an executive meeting room
stories.summary: Prosecutors say an OpenAI engineer planted a recording device in a conference room at the company's San Francisco office.
stories.why: AI labs guard valuable secrets, and an insider bugging executives would be a serious security breach.
stories.happened: OpenAI found the device behind a TV in an executive conference room on September 30 and called the FBI, SiliconANGLE reports. An engineer was arrested and charged with illegally intercepting communications; OpenAI fired him. OpenAI says it has no sign that model weights or customer data were taken.
stories.next: Watch for the court case and any findings on what, if anything, was recorded.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: OpenAI makes ChatGPT, one of the most used apps in the world.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: AI labs are seen as targets for spying.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The case raises questions about insider threats at AI companies.

stories.background: OpenAI is the company behind ChatGPT and the GPT models. It is based in San Francisco.

meme.bottom: The alleged threat used a USB port
meme.take: Charges are unproven, but every AI lab is now checking behind the meeting room TV.

stories.title: GTA 6 on PC is reported for the first three months of 2027
stories.summary: GamesBeat says Rockstar plans a PC release a few months after the November 19 console launch.
stories.why: PC players have been waiting to hear when they can play the biggest game of the year.
stories.happened: Rockstar plans to release GTA 6 on PC in the first quarter of 2027, GamesBeat reports, citing four people familiar with the plans, via Beebom. The game launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on November 19. Rockstar has not confirmed a PC date.
stories.next: Watch for any update at Take-Two's earnings on November 9.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games ever.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: PC players were left out of the launch plan.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It comes just over a month before release.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Rockstar's past GTA games reached PC after consoles.

meme.take: Reported PC date: early 2027. PC players: already arguing about graphics settings.

stories.title: Meta says hackers took code and data on about 1,500 people from its GitHub
stories.summary: Attackers used an employee's stolen login to reach some Meta code repositories, the company says.
stories.why: A breach at one of the largest tech companies shows how one stolen password can expose source code.
stories.happened: Attackers used stolen employee credentials to access some of Meta's GitHub repositories, SecurityWeek reports. Meta says 99% of what was taken was code, and the rest was personal data on about 1,500 people, mostly US employees, stored there against policy. Notifications began October 13.
stories.next: Watch for what personal data was involved and whether stolen code surfaces online.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 1,500 people are being notified.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Stolen logins remain a top way into company systems.

stories.background: GitHub is Microsoft's code hosting service, used by most software companies to store and share code.

meme.top: Policy: no personal data in repos
meme.take: Meta says 99% of what was taken was just code, which is the good news, somehow.

stats.label: of stolen data was code, Meta says

stories.title: GTA 6 leaker's meme coin crashes as it threatens to post the full game
stories.summary: Cyberleek promised escalating clips as its coin's value rose, then the coin lost half its value in a day.
stories.why: GTA 6 is the most anticipated game in years, and leaks this close to launch spread to millions within hours.
stories.happened: The leaker said it would post a full 200GB+ build if its meme coin hit a $30 million market cap, Kotaku reports. The coin passed $4.75 million over the weekend, then fell 50% in 24 hours to about $2.2 million. No playable build has been verified.
stories.next: Watch for legal action by Take-Two and fake 'build' downloads carrying malware.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: GTA 6 is one of the most anticipated games ever.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The threat comes about a month before release.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: The group ties its leaks to a crypto promotion and to the digital-only plan.

stories.background: Grand Theft Auto is Rockstar Games' open-world crime series. Take-Two Interactive is Rockstar's parent company.

meme.top: Leak plan: tied to a meme coin
meme.bottom: The coin did what coins do
meme.take: Threatening Rockstar via crypto: two volatile assets, one terrible plan.

stats.label: market cap demanded for full leak

stories.title: Anthropic warns small AI models may soon copy themselves across smart devices
stories.summary: Anthropic's red team says small open models could be months from spreading across cheap internet-connected gadgets.
stories.why: Self-copying AI on household gadgets would be a new kind of botnet that is hard to switch off.
stories.happened: In tests on cheap Android TV boxes with weakened security, models set up software and linked devices into networks, BleepingComputer reports. Qwen3.5-9B set up the software on eight of nine hardware types. No full self-replicating worm was shown on real devices.
stories.next: Watch for device makers' responses and whether other labs repeat the experiments.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Many cheap smart devices ship with weak default security.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Small open models keep getting more capable.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is a rare public test of AI spreading across gadgets.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company behind the Claude models. Its Frontier Red Team studies risks from advanced AI.

meme.top: Your cheap TV box from a random seller
meme.bottom: Possible part-time host for an AI
meme.take: Anthropic tested whether AI can spread across TV boxes. The TV boxes did not object.

stats.label: hardware types set up by Qwen

stories.title: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse earns strong reviews ahead of its October 15 launch
stories.summary: Konami's new Castlevania sits at 86 on Metacritic, with scores from 6 to 10 out of 10.
stories.why: It is the first new Castlevania game in years, and fans have waited a long time for one this well received.
stories.happened: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse, developed by Evil Empire, holds 86 on Metacritic and 85 on OpenCritic, Pure Xbox reports. GameSpot gave it 10/10 and IGN 8/10. It launches October 15 for $29.99.
stories.next: Watch for player reactions and sales after launch on October 15.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Castlevania is a decades-old Konami series.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans have waited years for a new main game.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives in a crowded October release window.

stories.background: Castlevania is Konami's long-running action series about the Belmont family's fight with Dracula.

meme.take: Dracula loses every Castlevania and still keeps booking sequels. Respect.

stories.title: Microsoft fixes a record 1,411 security flaws in one Patch Tuesday
stories.summary: October's update covers 1,411 flaws, including three zero-days, one already being exploited.
stories.why: Almost every Windows user and company has to install these fixes, and the count dwarfs past months.
stories.happened: Microsoft's October Patch Tuesday fixed 1,411 flaws, 70 of them rated critical, BleepingComputer reports. One zero-day, a Windows Shell flaw that bypasses Mark of the Web, is being exploited. The report links the volume to Microsoft using AI to find bugs.
stories.next: Watch for details of the exploited flaw and whether huge patch counts become normal.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: 1,411 fixes is a record for a single Patch Tuesday.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI tools are finding software bugs faster than before.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: One flaw is already being used in attacks.

stories.background: Patch Tuesday is Microsoft's monthly release of security fixes, on the second Tuesday of each month.

meme.bottom: Your weekend found a new purpose
meme.take: Microsoft's AI is great at finding bugs. Your reboot schedule is great at absorbing them.

stories.title: Nvidia's share of China's AI chip market falls to 34% as Huawei hits 28%
stories.summary: An IDC report says Nvidia's AI accelerator shipments to China fell 44% in the first half of 2026.
stories.why: China is one of the biggest AI chip markets, and export rules are pushing it toward local suppliers.
stories.happened: IDC data seen by Reuters shows Nvidia shipped 678,000 AI accelerators in China from January to June, down 44% year over year, Gizmochina reports. Huawei shipped 572,000 for a 28% share. Nine of 11 Chinese chipmakers tracked by IDC grew.
stories.next: Watch for whether Huawei overtakes Nvidia in China in the second half of the year.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Huawei is now six points behind Nvidia in China.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: US export limits and Beijing's self-reliance push both weigh on Nvidia.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Jensen Huang has put China's AI chip market at about $50 billion.

stories.background: Nvidia designs most of the chips used to train AI. Huawei is a Chinese tech group that also makes AI chips.

meme.top: Export rules aimed at China's AI
meme.bottom: Also landed on Nvidia's sales chart
meme.take: Huawei shipped 572,000 AI chips in China. A sanction turns out to be a decent sales pitch.

stories.title: Below and Ben Affleck's Animals top Netflix's charts in their first weeks
stories.summary: Below drew 17.0 million views and Animals 23.8 million, while Ice Age films filled half the English film top 10.
stories.why: Netflix's weekly charts show which new releases people actually watch.
stories.happened: Josh Hartnett's limited series Below led English TV with 17.0 million views for October 5 to 11, What's on Netflix reports. Animals led films with 23.8 million. Ice Age films, newly licensed from Disney, took half the English film top 10 spots.
stories.next: Watch for whether Below holds No. 1 in its second week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Ben Affleck stars in Animals.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Animals drew 23.8 million views in its first week.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Ice Age films returned to the chart through a Disney licensing deal.

stories.background: Netflix publishes weekly top 10 lists based on views, meaning hours watched divided by running time.

meme.bottom: Viewers: five Ice Age movies, please
meme.take: Half of Netflix's English film top 10 is Ice Age. The glacier beat the algorithm.

stats.label: Ice Age spots in film top 10

stories.title: Meta releases Muse Wonder, pitching it as a rival to ChatGPT and Claude
stories.summary: Meta's new Muse Wonder models are pitched against OpenAI and Anthropic on coding, reasoning and long agent tasks.
stories.why: It is Meta's clearest attempt yet to rejoin the race for the most capable AI models.
stories.happened: Meta launched Muse Wonder and a larger Muse Wonder Full on October 12. Artificial Analysis scored Full at 56 on its Intelligence Index, second behind Claude Opus 5.5, AI Weekly reports. API prices are reported at about $4 and $20 per million tokens.
stories.next: Watch for how Muse Wonder compares with Google's Gemini 4 Argon in independent tests.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Meta is pitching the models directly against OpenAI and Anthropic.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Meta spent about $14 billion on a Scale AI deal that brought in its AI chief.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows about 14 months of restructuring in Meta's AI unit.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. Its earlier Llama models were released with open weights.

meme.take: Meta spent years catching up and finished second, which in AI counts as a launch party.

stories.title: Epic reportedly orders an 'AI-first' workflow on its delayed Disney shooter
stories.summary: Bloomberg says developers were told to stop hand-writing code and artists to use AI, using Anthropic's Claude.
stories.why: It is one of the most direct moves yet by a major studio to replace parts of game development with AI.
stories.happened: Epic told staff on an unannounced shooter with Marvel and Star Wars characters to go AI-first, including generating art with AI, Bloomberg reports. The game is reportedly behind schedule. Epic said its approach is AI-accelerated development led by its own developers.
stories.next: Watch for staff reaction, any new release date and whether Epic applies the policy to other teams.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The game involves Marvel and Star Wars characters.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Bloomberg says many staff reacted with shock.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Disney invested $1.5 billion in Epic in 2024.

stories.background: Epic Games makes Fortnite and the Unreal Engine. Disney owns Marvel and Lucasfilm.

meme.bottom: New plan: AI does the art
meme.take: Epic says humans still lead the work. The AI, reportedly, handles the drawing part.

stories.title: NTT Data is reported near a deal to build Anthropic's first Japan data center
stories.summary: Nikkei says the Osaka site could cost about $6.3 billion and draw up to 500 megawatts.
stories.why: It would give Anthropic its own computing base in Japan as demand for AI services grows there.
stories.happened: NTT Data is reported to be in the final stages of talks to develop the Osaka Prefecture facility, DCD reports, citing Nikkei Asia. It would cost about $6.3 billion with up to 500MW of capacity, with partial operation from 2028. Neither company has commented.
stories.next: Watch for an official announcement and the final size of the project.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Up to 500MW would make it a very large data center.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported cost is about one trillion yen.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI labs are racing to secure computing capacity worldwide.

stories.background: Anthropic makes the Claude AI models. NTT Data is the IT services arm of Japan's NTT group.

meme.top: Anthropic wants a home in Japan
meme.take: Nothing says 'the cloud' like a reported $6.3 billion concrete building in Osaka.

stories.title: Jury finds Arm breached Qualcomm's license but awards just $2
stories.summary: A Delaware jury sided with Qualcomm in its second licensing fight with Arm and awarded nominal damages.
stories.why: The two companies' chip designs are inside most of the world's phones, so their legal fights matter widely.
stories.happened: A Delaware federal jury found Arm breached its license agreement and acted to disrupt Qualcomm's business, Thurrott reports. Qualcomm was awarded $2 in nominal damages after a five-day trial. Qualcomm had accused Arm of hurting a chip sale to Meta.
stories.next: Watch for any appeal by Arm and how the companies' license talks continue.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Arm and Qualcomm have fought in court since 2022.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Their chip designs power most smartphones.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: A win worth two dollars has drawn a lot of attention.

stories.background: Arm licenses chip designs used in most phones. Qualcomm makes Snapdragon processors built on Arm's technology.

meme.take: Qualcomm beat Arm in court and can now afford roughly half a coffee.

stories.title: Battlefield 6 Season 5 launches with Las Vegas maps and joins Game Pass
stories.summary: The new season and the game's Game Pass debut both arrived on October 13, ten days before Modern Warfare 4.
stories.why: Joining Game Pass on the same day could bring a large new audience to one of the year's big shooters.
stories.happened: Season 5 launched October 13 with Vegas Strip and Area 51 maps and a Rapid Royale mode, DayOne reports. A Dead Space event runs October 20 to November 7. Battlefield 6 also joined PC Game Pass and Game Pass Ultimate the same day.
stories.next: Watch for player numbers on Game Pass and how they hold once Modern Warfare 4 arrives.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players have long asked for a server browser.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The Game Pass launch lines up with the start of the new season.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Dead Space crossover revives a dormant Electronic Arts horror series.

stories.background: Battlefield is Electronic Arts' large-scale military shooter series. Dead Space is a sci-fi horror series also owned by EA.

meme.take: Battlefield's new season: Vegas, aliens and Game Pass. A normal Nevada weekend.

stories.title: Other Mommy opens at No. 1 with $27.5 million
stories.summary: The Jessica Chastain horror film took $27.5 million on a $19 million budget despite a D+ audience grade.
stories.why: October is horror season, and an original film leading the chart is a useful sign for cinemas.
stories.happened: Universal and Blumhouse's Other Mommy opened to $27.5 million and $45 million worldwide, TheWrap reports. Its D+ CinemaScore is the lowest since Megalopolis. Verity fell 64% to about $11.5 million in its second weekend, and Resident Evil was third.
stories.next: Watch for how sharply it falls next weekend given its weak audience score.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: A horror release in October has the calendar on its side.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: It took more than its $19 million budget in three days.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: A D+ CinemaScore means opening-night audiences did not like it.

stories.background: Blumhouse is a production company known for low-budget horror hits. Universal is one of Hollywood's major studios.

meme.take: Other Mommy proves people will pay good money to be disappointed, if it's scary.

stories.title: Hackers heat supermarket fridges across France, spoiling food
stories.summary: Intermarché, Carrefour, Super U and Monoprix stores were hit through outdated Danfoss refrigeration controllers.
stories.why: It is a rare attack where hacking caused direct physical damage in everyday shops.
stories.happened: Attackers remotely forced defrost cycles at refrigeration systems in French supermarkets from October 11, Infosecurity Magazine reports. Intermarché said 150 stores were hit and Carrefour 80. Danfoss said affected units ran obsolete or un-updated controllers. Belgium and the Netherlands were reportedly affected.
stories.next: Watch for findings from France's cybersecurity agency and whether attackers are identified.

drivers.label: Novelty
drivers.text: Remotely heating supermarket fridges is a new kind of attack.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Hundreds of stores across several chains were affected.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Researchers found thousands of these controllers exposed online.

stories.background: Danfoss is a Danish maker of refrigeration and heating equipment used in shops worldwide.

meme.bottom: The internet turned up the heat
meme.take: Lesson from France: a fridge does not need Wi-Fi to stay cool. It needs the opposite.

stories.title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign early access starts October 16
stories.summary: Digital pre-order buyers can play the campaign a week before the October 23 launch on PS5, Xbox, PC and Switch 2.
stories.why: Call of Duty is one of the best-selling series every year, and this is its first entry on Switch 2.
stories.happened: Modern Warfare 4's campaign opens early on October 16 for digital pre-orders, with DMZ early access on October 20, GamingBible reports. The full game launches October 23. PC needs 115GB of free SSD space, and the game is not on Game Pass at launch.
stories.next: Watch for reviews of the campaign and launch player numbers on October 23.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Call of Duty is one of gaming's biggest yearly releases.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Battlefield 6 joined Game Pass ten days before its launch.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: It is coming to Nintendo Switch 2.

stories.background: Call of Duty is Activision's military shooter series. Activision is owned by Microsoft.

meme.take: Modern Warfare 4 lands on Switch 2, so the war is now portable. Bring a charger.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils Maia 300, its own AI chip, to run Copilot from 2027
stories.summary: The third-generation inference chip is built on TSMC's N2P process and is meant to cut Microsoft's reliance on Nvidia.
stories.why: Every big cloud company wants its own AI chips to control costs and supply.
stories.happened: Microsoft announced Maia 300 on October 12 and said it will become the main system for running AI in Copilot from 2027, at gigawatt scale. It claims 40% more tokens per megawatt than top GPU systems. Each rack holds 96 chips and draws about 167 kW, The Next Web says.
stories.next: Watch for more detail at Microsoft's Ignite conference in November.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Custom chips let Microsoft buy fewer Nvidia GPUs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Deployments are planned at gigawatt scale from 2027.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Running AI models is one of the biggest costs for cloud firms.

stories.background: Microsoft sells AI tools under the Copilot brand and runs the Azure cloud. Maia is its in-house line of AI chips.

meme.bottom: Also Microsoft: built its own chip
meme.take: Microsoft and Nvidia's relationship status: it's complicated, starting in 2027.

stories.title: Ledger confirms a hardware implant behind crypto thefts from resold wallets
stories.summary: Devices sold through one reseller, CryptoBilis, carried an implant tied to drained crypto wallets, Ledger says.
stories.why: Hardware wallets are sold as the safest way to hold crypto, so a tampered device undercuts that promise.
stories.happened: Ledger said one affected user's device contained an unauthorized hardware implant, BleepingComputer reports. It linked all reported unexpected drains to devices sold through CryptoBilis, a Malaysia-based reseller it told to stop selling. Ledger called the number affected limited.
stories.next: Watch for how many users were hit and what Ledger offers them.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Tampered hardware is hard for buyers to detect.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Attackers are targeting the crypto supply chain.

stories.background: Ledger is a French company that makes hardware wallets for storing cryptocurrency offline.

meme.bottom: Unless it shipped with a guest
meme.take: Plain lesson from the Ledger case: buy security devices from the maker, not a middleman.

stories.title: Fox releases the first trailer for its Baywatch reboot, premiering in January
stories.summary: Stephen Amell leads the new 12-episode Baywatch, with some original cast members returning as guests.
stories.why: Baywatch was one of the most watched shows in the world in the 1990s.
stories.happened: Fox released the official trailer for its Baywatch reboot, premiering in January 2027, mxdwn reports. Stephen Amell plays Captain Hobie Buchannon, and Matt Nix is showrunner. David Chokachi returns in a recurring role.
stories.next: Watch for an exact premiere date and more returning cast announcements.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Original cast members return for the new season.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Stephen Amell led the series Arrow for eight seasons.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Networks keep reviving 1990s hits.

stories.background: Baywatch ran from 1989 to 2001 and followed lifeguards in Los Angeles County.

meme.bottom: Rescuing the 90s, one reboot at a time
meme.take: Television has found the one thing it can always rescue: an old brand name.

stories.title: Linus Torvalds posts a Linux kernel branch written with help from Claude Code
stories.summary: The experimental patches rework how Linux reads cached files and are not yet merged into the kernel.
stories.why: The creator of Linux using an AI coding tool on core kernel code is a notable signal for programmers.
stories.happened: Torvalds published a branch that lets the page cache be read without folio reference counting, aimed at many threads making small reads from one file, Phoronix reports. He wrote that it was done with Claude Code under his direction. Some outlets report small-read throughput roughly tripled.
stories.next: Watch for whether the patches are accepted in a coming Linux merge window.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Torvalds created Linux and still leads its development.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI coding tools are spreading among experienced developers.

drivers.label: Novelty
drivers.text: AI-assisted work on kernel internals by Torvalds himself is new.

stories.background: Linux is the open-source operating system kernel behind most servers and Android phones. Torvalds started it in 1991.

meme.bottom: Now with a credited AI helper
meme.take: The Linux kernel has AI-assisted patches; the review process remains extremely human.

stories.title: Practical Magic 2 arrives on digital after its box office run
stories.summary: The Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman sequel is now available to rent or buy on digital stores.
stories.why: The sequel came 28 years after the original, which built a large fan base on home video.
stories.happened: Practical Magic 2 became available to rent or buy on digital platforms including Prime Video and Apple TV, ComingSoon reports. Warner Bros. moved it to home viewing after a run that Yahoo reports passed $100 million.
stories.next: Watch for when it reaches HBO Max for subscribers.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: It revisits a 1998 fan favorite.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Sandra Bullock and Nicole Kidman return.

stories.background: Practical Magic was a 1998 film about witch sisters, based on Alice Hoffman's novel.

meme.take: Practical Magic 2 made its money in cinemas. Now it haunts your rental queue.

stories.title: AI agent startup Decagon is reported in early buyout talks with ServiceNow
stories.summary: Business Insider says Decagon, last valued at $4.5 billion, has hired an investment bank to field interest.
stories.why: It would be one of the bigger deals for a startup selling AI customer service agents.
stories.happened: Decagon has hired an investment bank and is in early talks with ServiceNow and other possible buyers, Business Insider reports. The company was last valued at $4.5 billion. No deal has been announced.
stories.next: Watch for whether ServiceNow or another buyer makes a formal offer.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Decagon was last valued at $4.5 billion.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Large software firms are buying AI agent startups.

stories.background: Decagon builds AI agents that answer customer service questions. ServiceNow sells workflow software to large businesses.

meme.take: Decagon automated the help desk. Now buyers are reportedly asking to speak to a manager.

stories.title: Ahold Delhaize takes systems offline after a cyber incident
stories.summary: Albert Heijn warned of empty shelves as distribution centers stopped, and US chains' websites went down.
stories.why: The group runs thousands of grocery stores used by millions of shoppers each week.
stories.happened: Ahold Delhaize took systems offline after a cybersecurity incident that began on October 11. Work stopped at several Albert Heijn distribution centers, NL Times reports, and Food Lion, Stop & Shop and Hannaford websites went down. Stores stayed open. Its shares fell 3.15%.
stories.next: Watch for how long restoration takes and whether customer data was affected.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The group serves about 60 million customers a week.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It hit the same weekend as attacks on French supermarkets.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Fresh food deliveries were disrupted.

stories.background: Ahold Delhaize is a Dutch-Belgian group that owns Albert Heijn, Delhaize, Food Lion, Stop & Shop and Hannaford.

meme.take: A plain update: Ahold Delhaize's stores stayed open while its systems were restored.

stories.title: IMF raises its 2026 growth forecast and credits the AI investment boom
stories.summary: The IMF now sees 3.1% global growth this year and modeled the cost of a sudden pullback in AI spending.
stories.why: It shows how much the world economy now leans on spending for AI data centers and chips.
stories.happened: The IMF raised its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1%, citing the AI investment boom, ABC News reports. It also modeled a downside case in which a reversal in AI spending leaves world output 1.1% below its baseline by 2028.
stories.next: Watch for whether big tech firms keep raising AI spending in their next earnings reports.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: AI spending is now big enough to move global forecasts.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The IMF modeled what happens if AI spending reverses.

stories.background: The International Monetary Fund is a global financial institution that publishes forecasts for the world economy.

meme.take: The IMF's forecast has a new risk: everyone stops buying GPUs at the same time.

stories.title: Steam sets a new record with 43.5 million users online at once
stories.summary: SteamDB recorded the all-time peak on October 11, though only about a third of users were in a game.
stories.why: It shows PC gaming is still growing even as console sales fall.
stories.happened: Steam hit 43,505,724 concurrent users on October 11, per SteamDB, Xenospectrum reports. A later snapshot that day found about 32.8% of connected users actually in a game. Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 had the highest daily peaks.
stories.next: Watch for whether the record falls again during the holiday sales.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 43 million people were logged in at once.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Steam has set repeated records in recent years.

stories.background: Steam is Valve's PC game store and launcher, the largest of its kind.

meme.bottom: Most of them not playing anything
meme.take: Steam set a record crowd, and a later snapshot found most just idling. Relatable.

stories.title: Anthropic says new safeguards cut model copying by 90% or more
stories.summary: The company says changes made against distillation sharply reduced attempts to harvest Claude's outputs to train rivals.
stories.why: Copying a model through its answers is a cheap way for rivals to catch up, so labs guard against it.
stories.happened: Anthropic said on October 12 that new safeguards reduced data harvesting by distillers by roughly 90 to 99%, AI Weekly reports. Distillation means training a model on another model's outputs.
stories.next: Watch for whether other AI labs describe similar defenses.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Labs worry competitors train on their models' answers.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Training a top model from scratch costs far more than copying one.

stories.background: Anthropic is the AI company that makes the Claude models.

meme.take: Anthropic says copycats now get 90% less help. Back to studying the hard way.

stories.title: Ivanti warns a Connect Secure zero-day is being exploited in attacks
stories.summary: Ivanti urged customers to patch a flaw in its Connect Secure remote access gateway that attackers are already using.
stories.why: Remote access gateways guard company networks, so exploited flaws there can let attackers in.
stories.happened: Ivanti warned on October 13 that a zero-day flaw in Connect Secure is being exploited in attacks, BleepingComputer reports. The company urged customers to install its fix.
stories.next: Watch for details on who was targeted and whether government agencies order emergency patching.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: The flaw is already being exploited.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Ivanti's gateways have been hit by several zero-days in recent years.

stories.background: Ivanti sells IT management and security software. Connect Secure is its VPN gateway for remote workers.

meme.take: Plain advice for Connect Secure admins: install Ivanti's fix before anything else.

stories.title: Taylor Swift becomes the first solo act with 100 weeks at No. 1
stories.summary: The Life of a Showgirl spent a 14th week atop the Billboard 200, leaving only the Beatles ahead of her on the all-time list.
stories.why: It is a rare chart record, and only one act in history has more weeks at the top.
stories.happened: The Life of a Showgirl earned 93,000 units to lead the Billboard 200 for a 14th week, Billboard reports. That gives Swift 100 weeks at No. 1 across 15 albums, behind the Beatles' 132. The Beatles' Rubber Soul also returned to No. 4.
stories.next: Watch for whether the album extends its run on next week's chart.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Swift is one of the best-selling artists in the world.

drivers.label: Record
drivers.text: No solo act had reached 100 weeks at No. 1 before.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: An expanded Encore edition added four new songs.

stories.background: The Billboard 200 ranks the most popular albums in the US each week, combining sales and streams.

meme.take: The all-time chart race is close, and one side stopped recording in 1970.

stories.title: Drone strikes shut a third Yandex data center in four days
stories.summary: Russian taxi, cloud and smart home services went down after the Vladimir site closed on October 11.
stories.why: Data centers have become wartime targets, with direct effects on everyday apps.
stories.happened: Drone attacks damaged three Yandex data centers, forcing two to shut and one to be partly disabled, BleepingComputer reports. Yandex confirmed outages as users lost access to cloud files. Yandex Go taxi ordering also failed across Russia.
stories.next: Watch for how quickly Yandex restores services and whether more sites are hit.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: More than 80 Yandex Cloud services were disrupted, Kyiv Post says.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Yandex has added drone attacks to its force majeure terms.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Three sites were hit within four days.

stories.background: Yandex is Russia's largest internet company, running search, taxis, maps and cloud services.

meme.take: A sober reminder that war now reaches the cloud and the apps people rely on.

stats.label: data centers hit in four days

stories.title: Nvidia opens its Vera Rubin rack designs, and Meta adopts its Spectrum-6 switches
stories.summary: At the OCP Global Summit, Nvidia contributed rack and tray designs so other firms can build compatible AI systems.
stories.why: Shared designs can make it faster and cheaper to build the data centers that run AI.
stories.happened: Nvidia contributed Vera Rubin rack and compute tray designs to the Open Compute Project through MGX 1.2, which supports racks up to 250 kW with liquid cooling. Meta is adopting Nvidia's Spectrum-6 Ethernet switches for AI clusters beyond 100,000 GPUs, Nvidia says.
stories.next: Watch for which server makers ship Vera Rubin racks built on the open designs.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Designs target AI clusters of more than 100,000 GPUs.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia supplies most of the chips used to train AI.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Power and cooling are now the main limits on AI data centers.

stories.background: The Open Compute Project is an industry group, started by Facebook in 2011, that shares data center hardware designs.

meme.bottom: The chips: still very much for sale
meme.take: Nvidia open-sourced the furniture and kept the expensive stuff in the store.

stories.title: Marvel Tokon adds Jane Foster, Venom and Jubilee as Year 1 DLC
stories.summary: Three more fighters are coming to Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls after launch, alongside Phoenix Cyclops in November.
stories.why: Fighting game fans follow roster news closely, and Marvel characters draw a wide audience.
stories.happened: Jane Foster, Venom and Jubilee will join Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls as Year 1 downloadable content, Game Informer reports. Phoenix Cyclops arrives first, in November.
stories.next: Watch for release dates and gameplay reveals for the new fighters.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Roster reveals are big moments for fighting game players.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: The game uses Marvel's comic book heroes.

stories.background: Marvel Tokon: Fighting Souls is a tag-team fighting game made by Arc System Works and published by PlayStation.

meme.take: Marvel Tokon adds three fighters, because no Marvel roster has ever been finished.

stories.title: It Takes Two comes to Switch 2 on October 15 with cross-play
stories.summary: EA's co-op hit gets a free upgrade for Switch owners, with 1080p and 60fps when docked.
stories.why: It Takes Two is one of the most popular co-op games, and cross-play lets friends on other consoles join.
stories.happened: It Takes Two arrives on Switch 2 on October 15 as a free upgrade for Switch 1 owners, Nintendo Life reports. It runs at 1080p and 60fps docked and supports cross-play with PC, Xbox and PlayStation. The Friend's Pass stays.
stories.next: Watch for how the Switch 2 version performs in handheld mode.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Co-op fans have asked for wider cross-play.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It lands in a busy week of Switch 2 releases.

stories.background: It Takes Two is a two-player co-op adventure from Hazelight Studios, published by Electronic Arts in 2021.

meme.top: A game you can't play alone
meme.take: It Takes Two arrives on Switch 2, still refusing to be anyone's solo hobby.

stories.title: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy's Sacrifice comes to Netflix on October 16
stories.summary: The apocalyptic comedy-thriller leads a busy week of new streaming films.
stories.why: Two well-known stars in a Netflix film usually means a big first weekend on the service.
stories.happened: Sacrifice, an apocalyptic comedy-thriller starring Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy, streams on Netflix from October 16, Tom's Guide reports. Vincent Cassel, John Malkovich and Salma Hayek also appear.
stories.next: Watch for its debut on Netflix's top 10 next week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy lead the cast.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It arrives in a crowded week for streaming films.

stories.background: Netflix is the largest subscription streaming service and releases new films every week.

meme.bottom: Friday, on Netflix, as a comedy
meme.take: Netflix found the bright side of the end of the world. It streams from October 16.

stories.title: The Social Reckoning opens to $5.5 million in fifth place
stories.summary: Aaron Sorkin's follow-up to The Social Network opened fifth, below a third of the original's 2010 debut.
stories.why: It follows a much-loved film and tackles a company that is still in the headlines.
stories.happened: The Social Reckoning took $5.5 million in its opening weekend, TheWrap reports, less than a third of The Social Network's $22.6 million start. It earned a B- CinemaScore and has a reported net budget of about $30 million from Sony and Alcon.
stories.next: Watch for whether awards attention helps its run in the coming weeks.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: The Social Network is one of the most acclaimed films of its decade.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Forecasts sit well below what the original opened to.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its subject, Facebook's parent company Meta, is still in the news every week.

stories.background: Aaron Sorkin won an Academy Award for writing The Social Network.

meme.take: The Facebook sequel opened like an old account: still there, few people checking in.
